content.text: {"locale":"en","answer":"An ordinary change alters particular features within an existing arrangement—for example, population size, urban scale, infrastructure, education, or wealth may grow while the underlying structure continues to operate in the same way. Civilizational reconfiguration, by contrast, concerns whether the deep relationships organizing those changes have been rearranged: whether power, resources, responsibility, risk, and the future are being allocated through a different set of relations.
